newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shui On gets US$78 mln loan for Shanghai project.
newsitem.headline: Shui On gets US$78 mln loan for Shanghai project.

text.p: Shui On Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has signed an agreement with Bank of China in Hong Kong to borrow US$78 million to build a development in Shanghai.
The project, Rui Hong Xin Cheng in northwest Hongkou district, is developed by Shanghai Ruichen Property Co Ltd, a joint venture between Shui On and Shanghai Zhonghong Group.
Shui On has 99 percent interest in the venture, which includes 1.42 million square metres of residential space and 250,000 sq m of commercial facilities on a 40-hectare site.
Construction of phase one, which would provide 180,000 sq m of residential space and commercial facilities, would start in December, it said in a statement.
